desc:
🐉 Steal from Dragons!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal Eggs from Dragon Nests across the Islands
🔥 Outfly the Guardian Dragon before it catches you
🏡 Hatch your Dragons on your Ranch to earn Cash
⚡ Upgrade your Speed to reach faster, rarer Dragons
✨ Hatch Mutated Dragons for even more Cash
🌈 Collect every Dragon in the Index, from Common to Secret
☁️ Rebirth to unlock Heaven and fly even higher

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players
